user.title: CellKeeper
user.description:
Adds the CellKeeper dashboard, with a dashboard in the sidebar for each pack that doesn't have one yet, and keeps a long-term history of your CellKeeper packs, apart from the recorder's 10 days.

Packs found: {packs}

abort.single_instance_allowed: CellKeeper is already set up; it logs every pack it finds.

old_dashboard_install.title: The separate CellKeeper Dashboard install is still loaded

confirm.title: Remove the separate CellKeeper Dashboard install
confirm.description:
The dashboard now comes with the CellKeeper integration. The separate install (HACS, CellKeeper Dashboard) is still a Lovelace resource ({url}), so two copies of the same cards load.

Submit to remove that resource. Your dashboards keep working, on the integration's copy. Then remove CellKeeper Dashboard in HACS too.

data.create_dashboards: Make a dashboard for each new pack

data_description.create_dashboards: Once per pack, when one is found that no dashboard shows yet. A dashboard you change or delete stays that way.
